python.build: A relate-db wheel that maturin built from surfaces/relate-python at upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2), installed in a venv with the pinned frameworks.

crewai.build: The same relate-db wheel (maturin, surfaces/relate-python at upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2)), installed in a second venv with crewai, whose pins would hold the main venv's frameworks back.

js.build: A copy of clients/javascript at upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2) with koffi, loading librelate_ffi built from the same commit (cargo build -p relate-ffi --release), with the pinned frameworks beside it.

rust.build: The relate crate from a checkout of upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2), as a path dependency of a template project carrying that commit's Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml.

java.build: A copy of clients/java at upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2) packaged with Maven 3.10.0 (relate-0.1.2.jar, with JNA 5.14.0 and Jackson databind 2.17.2 on the classpath), loading librelate_ffi built from the same commit.

go.build: clients/go from a checkout of upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2), built with cgo against relate.h and librelate_ffi built from the same commit.

swift.build: A copy of Package.swift and clients/swift at upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2), with an XCFramework made from librelate_ffi built from the same commit.

c.build: relate.h and librelate_ffi built from upstream v0.1.2 (f0c09d2) (cargo build -p relate-ffi --release).
